description: Versioned suengj.com visual brand profile (AES-V2.7 / SUE-565). Encodes the current stable visual character so a compiled visual job records exactly which version it compiled against. This repository owns why the profile looks this way and what it forbids; suengj-com owns the canonical design-token values.
priority_rule: A reference's colour or style may not silently override this brand profile. A reference trait may only outrank the brand default when it is explicitly selected as an authoritative trait for the job (see schemas/visual-job.schema.json selected_reference_traits). Absent that explicit selection, this priority order is binding, highest first.

primary_structure.family: muted forest / sage green — the structural identity color, not a saturation effect
primary_structure.observed_value: muted sage / desaturated green with a deeper forest/moss variant for hierarchy

accent.family: restrained sand / camel — accent only, never a second dominant palette
accent.observed_value: muted camel / sand / brown, sparse use

neutral.family: warm gray / stone / charcoal — hierarchy and contrast, never a fill for the whole composition
neutral.observed_value: quiet charcoal for typography and linework

line_and_materiality.line_weight: thin, quiet, purposeful; low visual weight relative to primary blocks
line_and_materiality.line_role: connectors clarify hierarchy rather than build a dense network; dashed lines may indicate secondary or inferred relationships
line_and_materiality.depth_model: flat or nearly flat 2D composition; a small amount of tonal separation, faint ground plane, or soft card-edge separation is acceptable
line_and_materiality.materiality_ceiling: never glossy glass, heavy shadow, cinematic 3D, or chrome objects

stable_visual_properties.accent: one restrained accent family; at most two when semantically useful
stable_visual_properties.geometry: flat or nearly flat, modular, clean
stable_visual_properties.layout: editorial grid, clear alignment, strong grouping
stable_visual_properties.text: deterministic outside generated artwork when load-bearing

desired_impression.one_line: The goal is visual argument, not visual spectacle (editorial/ARTICLE-ILLUSTRATION-ROUTING.md §3).

research_data: floating formulas with no semantic role

taste_calibration_evidence.preference_order_note: Four variants of the same article concept were reviewed with the owner; preference order 2 > 4 > 3 > 1. The ranking is evidence about visual character, not authority over the exact composition or subject matter of those specific images.
preferred_qualities: muted forest/sage green with a restrained sand/camel accent
a small amount of physical depth or material presence without glossy 3D
fewer, larger compositional groups rather than many small icons
soft hierarchy and editorial calm rather than obvious infographic loudness
less_preferred_qualities: many tiny UI fragments or mini charts competing at once
every object enclosed in a heavy card or container
flat vector sterility with no tonal/material nuance

resolution_boundary.note: Canonical design tokens (exact hex/HSL values, type scale, spacing scale) live in suengj-com, not this repository. Every token above is recorded as a reference plus an observed value and observation date, marked resolved_from suengj-com, per docs/architecture/SSOT-BOUNDARIES.md. A future site redesign updates the publication profile; it does not retroactively change what a job compiled against an earlier profile_version meant.
